course_name: STA4442 Introduction to Probability and Statistics

policies.late_submission: Late assignments lose 10% per day for the first 3 days. Starting on day 4, an additional 10% is deducted each day (e.g., 40% on day 4, 50% on day 5). If the assignment is not submitted within 7 days after the deadline, it receives no credit.
policies.extension: Extensions require prior approval. Students must request at least 24 hours before the deadline with a documented reason. Approved extensions may be submitted during my office hours or placed in my mailbox in the main office (OSB210).
policies.office_hours: Office hours: Tue/Thu 1:00-2:15pm in Room OSB408. No appointment needed for first-come-first-served.
policies.assignment_dropoff: If you are not available to submit your assignment on Friday, you may submit it in advance during my office hours in OSB408.
policies.regrading: Regrade requests must be submitted within 1 week of grade release. Include specific question and justification.
policies.academic_integrity: All work must be original. Collaboration is allowed only where explicitly stated in assignment.

escalation_rules.description: Grade disputes or regrade requests must be escalated to instructor
Requests for a makeup exam must be reviewed and approved by the instructor before the TA can confirm any arrangement
